title: Heterogeneous Space Data Centers: A Key Paradigm for Future Non-Terrestrial and In-Orbit Services
abstract: arXiv:2610.32260v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Lower space-launch cost and advances in AI are driving space-based data centers (SDCs) that provide AI-centric computing and communication services to in-orbit and non-terrestrial assets. However, architectural principles, service models, and energy provisioning for such SDCs, particularly in low-Earth orbit (LEO), remain largely unexplored. We introduce heterogeneous SDCs composed of large and small nodes, differentiated by computing capability, size, and power budget, to support applications spanning ground, aerial, and in-orbit users. We define use cases, node sizing and placement strategies, and interconnection topologies integrating space-to-space and space-to-ground links. Focusing on dawn-dusk LEO configurations, we analyze solar power availability, visibility windows, and latency-aware coverage. translated_title: 异构空间数据中心：未来非地面与在轨服务的关键范式
translated_abstract: 更低的空间发射成本与人工智能的进步，正在推动天基数据中心的发展，为在轨及非地面资产提供以AI为中心的计算与通信服务。然而，此类SDC的架构原则、服务模型和能源供给，尤其是在近地轨道（LEO）环境下的实现，在很大程度上仍属空白。我们提出了由大小节点组成的异构空间数据中心，这些节点在计算能力、尺寸和功率预算上有所区分，以支持覆盖地面、空中和在轨用户的各类应用。我们定义了相关用例、节点规模与部署策略，以及整合空-空链路与空-地链路的互连拓扑。聚焦于晨昏轨道LEO配置，我们分析了太阳能电力可用性、可见时间窗口以及延迟感知的覆盖能力。基于典型场景的基线工作负载，我们评估了延迟和服务可靠性，并量化了不同配置的能源需求。
tldr: 本文提出由大小异构节点构成的空间数据中心新范式，定义了其用例、节点部署与空-空/空-地互连拓扑，并针对晨昏近地轨道配置分析太阳能供给、可见窗口与延迟，评估了服务延迟与可靠性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a heterogeneous space data center paradigm composed of large and small nodes, defines use cases, node sizing, placement, and space-to-space/ground interconnection topologies, and evaluates latency and service reliability for dawn-dusk LEO configurations.
